arbitrary.text: Connecting the lining to the whole body before adding macrophages felt like an unexplained prerequisite, even though both parts' jobs were clear.

continue.text: I might try another chapter if it connected familiar body parts through a similarly clear process, though I would hope for fewer unexplained assembly-order requirements.
